answer: At dawn, agents archive ember detections from a karst forest with three storage providers. To prevent one operator posing as all three, require each provider key to carry an ownership certificate from an independent registrar. Group subsidiaries under their controlling owner and accept at most one replica toward the redundancy target per group. Replacing keys or creating agent names cannot manufacture another group. This resists fake organizational diversity, but relies on accurate ownership checks; distinct owners may still share a data center or collude.
